steps.action: Resolve current human project intent. Ambiguous intent means ASK_HUMAN_WRITE_NOWHERE.
Validate PROJECT_IDENTITY_LOCK.json and every proposed writable destination.
Load DEVICE_RECOVERY_CONTRACT.json. Device mutation is not actionable if the required recovery tier is unvalidated.
Load only this project's manifest as authority and verify repository/coordination binding.
Load role-specific authority. Research and Manager roles have no production-write authority by default.
Load project-local state, accepted findings, evidence, and active experiment status.
Only now may tasks, handoffs, research queues, or implementation work become actionable.
